definition_sentence: A delivery is defined as high-pressure when match context demands immediate high-leverage execution: specifically during steep chases (RRR >= 9.5), death-over contests, severe batting collapses (<=3 wickets in hand), or critical playoff knockout stages.

scoring_weights_bowler.rate_basis: IPL/T20I weighted legal-ball economy; death econ soft-capped

board_policy: Auction Official is the primary freeze (IPL sample floors + weighted rates). Global Combined is a secondary board without IPL floors for methodology context.
